text: Charles Darwin's On the Origin of Species was banned from Trinity College, Cambridge, England, in 1859. The book was banned in Germany in 1933 by the Nazi regime for conflicting with ideological views on race and creation, and in Greece in 1937.
meta_description: On the Origin of Species by Charles Darwin: banned from Trinity College, Cambridge in 1859, in Germany in 1933 and in Greece in 1937.
